crossRefs.note: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be…
My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Jezebel
people.line: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

translations.web: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned, and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”
translations.bsb: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, “Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, who refused to give it to you for silver. For Naboth is no longer alive, but dead.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
